mission: Build a vehicle-side OTA update system with Master orchestrator, Linux/FreeRTOS agents, bootloader plugin layer, CLI packaging tool, and mock cloud server. All on x86 Linux, agents simulated as separate processes.

phases.name: Phase 0: Infrastructure
phases.description: Install system dependencies, generate test fixtures. No code written yet — just environment readiness.

tasks.title: Install system dependencies (apt packages)
tasks.description:
Install required system libraries:
  sudo apt install -y libcurl4-openssl-dev libarchive-dev
Optionally: sudo apt install -y gcovr valgrind clang-tidy

Verification:
  pkg-config --exists libcurl && echo OK
  pkg-config --exists libarchive && echo OK

See test-strategy.md 'Needs Installation Before Development' section.
This task BLOCKS all C/C++ builds that link libcurl (Master cloud client, download manager) or libarchive (ota-pack, agent installer).

tasks.title: Generate ECDSA P-256 test keypair
tasks.description:
Generate test signing keys for package verification:
  mkdir -p tests/fixtures/keys
  openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out tests/fixtures/keys/test_private.pem
  openssl ec -in tests/fixtures/keys/test_private.pem -pubout -out tests/fixtures/keys/test_public.pem

Verification:
  openssl ec -in tests/fixtures/keys/test_private.pem -check -noout
  openssl ec -in tests/fixtures/keys/test_public.pem -pubin -text -noout

See test-strategy.md Tier 4: infra-test-keys.
BLOCKS: ALL crypto tests, ALL verification tests, ALL signing tests, test fixture package generation.

   - ota_bootloader_destroy(iface) → frees plugin
   - Supports plugin names: 'sim', 'linux-generic' (shared-contracts.md §11 constants)
   - Unknown plugin → returns nullptr

3. src/ota-agent/bootloader/sim_plugin.cpp:
   - Simulates A/B flash slots using temp files
   - detect_inactive_slot: returns slot_b if slot_a active (and vice versa)
   - stage_firmware: writes data to file at offset
   - prepare_activation: marks staged slot as pending
   - query_boot_status: returns both slots' states
   - mark_active_valid: clears pending_activation
   - mark_slot_invalid: sets is_valid=false on specified slot
   - Context struct holds file paths for slot_a and slot_b (from config_json)

4. src/ota-agent/bootloader/linux_generic_plugin.cpp:
   - Similar to sim but uses partition metadata files
   - For x86 dev: reads/writes JSON metadata files (simulating UBoot env vars)

5. src/ota-agent/CMakeLists.txt — Add bootloader sources, create bootloader sub-target or include in agent build

6. tests/unit/bootloader/CMakeLists.txt — unit_bootloader_tests executable

Acceptance criteria:

tasks.title: Build Master: Cloud Client + Download Manager + Verification Pipeline
tasks.description:
Build the Master modules responsible for fetching packages from cloud, managing downloads, and verifying package integrity.

Files to create:

Namespace: ota::master

1. src/ota-master/cloud/cloud_client.hpp + cloud_client.cpp:
   - class CloudClient
   - Constructor takes base_url, timeout_seconds, retry_count from Config
   - checkForUpdates(node_identifier, region) → vector<UpdateInfo>
   - getManifest(package_id, version) → manifest JSON string
   - getMetadata(package_id, version) → PackageMetadata (size, crc32, sha256, signature)
   - downloadPackage(url, output_path, resume_from_byte) → downloaded bytes
   - Uses libcurl with CURLOPT_RANGE for resume, CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION for streaming
   - HTTP error handling: 404→OTA_ERR_NOT_FOUND, 5xx→retry, timeout→OTA_ERR_TIMEOUT
   - See tech-spec.md §5 for all API endpoints

2. src/ota-master/download/download_manager.hpp + download_manager.cpp:
   - class DownloadManager
   - startDownload(package_id, version, url, metadata) → download_id
   - resumeDownload(download_id) → continues from downloaded_bytes
   - pauseDownload(download_id)
   - cancelDownload(download_id)
   - supersede(old_download_id, new_package_id, new_version) → marks old as 'superseded'
   - getDownloadState(download_id) → DownloadState
   - Persistent state via Database (downloads table) + state JSON files
   - File naming: {pkg_id}_{version}.ota.partial → .ota on completion
   See shared-contracts.md §15 for file path patterns

3. src/ota-master/download/download_state.hpp + download_state.cpp:
   - class DownloadState
   - Serializable to/from JSON for persistence at /var/lib/ota/downloads/{pkg}_{ver}.state.json
   - Fields match downloads table columns from shared-contracts.md §12

4. src/ota-master/verification/verification_pipeline.hpp + verification_pipeline.cpp:
   - class VerificationPipeline
   - verify(package_path, expected_size, expected_crc32, expected_sha256, signature, pubkey_path) → ota_error_t
   - Pipeline order: size → CRC32 → SHA-256 → ECDSA P-256 (STOPS on first failure)
   - Uses libota-core crypto functions (ota_crc32, ota_sha256_file, ota_ecdsa_verify)
   - Each step logs result via spdlog
   - Returns specific error code per shared-contracts.md §4 (200-204)

Acceptance criteria:
   cmake --build build --target ota-master -j$(nproc)  → compiles+links with libcurl
   CloudClient, DownloadManager, VerificationPipeline classes compile

4. tests/fixtures/packages/bad_signature.ota:
   - Create valid package
   - Generate a SECOND keypair (not the test keys)
   - Sign with the second key
   - Package content valid, but signature won't verify with test_public.pem

Also compute and record metadata for each package:
   - File size (bytes)
   - CRC32 value
   - SHA-256 hex digest
   Store in tests/fixtures/packages/metadata.json for test reference

Acceptance criteria:
   All 4 .ota files exist in tests/fixtures/packages/
   ota-pack verify test_public.pem valid_sw_package.ota → success
   ota-pack verify test_public.pem corrupted_package.ota → failure
   ota-pack verify test_public.pem bad_signature.ota → failure
   metadata.json contains size, crc32, sha256 for each package

REFERENCE: shared-contracts.md §16 for test package IDs and versions.

tasks.title: Full codebase quality evaluation
tasks.description:
Run the judge skill to evaluate the entire codebase:

1. Build: cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DOTA_BUILD_TESTS=ON && cmake --build build -j$(nproc) → zero warnings
2. All tests: cd build && ctest --output-on-failure → ALL PASS
3. Coverage: gcovr → check thresholds (80% libota-core, 70% master/agent)
4. Contract compliance: Verify all identifiers in code match shared-contracts.md
5. Mock contamination: grep for mocks outside tests/unit/ → zero hits
6. Skip check: grep for GTEST_SKIP/DISABLED_ → zero hits
7. Architecture review: File structure matches tech-spec.md §2
8. State machine compliance: All transitions match shared-contracts.md §6
9. Protocol compliance: All message types and JSON schemas match shared-contracts.md §5
10. Security review: Verification pipeline order (size→CRC32→SHA256→ECDSA), no key material in code

Output: Quality report with pass/fail for each gate.

tasks.title: Generate quality report
